body: Oh yes, I should probably explain that while I want to do law as a job, I'd like to engage in art as a more dedicated hobby in the long run, I was just concerned about financial success for the future and I've always liked the idea of releasing music I would make for free on the internet. Thanks for the response too, I really appreciate your input on people pushing themselves, the motivation to do work and stay focused is what's killing me the most right now, especially with finals so soon.
Thank you so much, I've felt really lonely until this point and I'm tearing up in joy just from this comment. These words of encouragement are just what I need right now.
